Operated by Panda Zino LTD, our platform was engineered to give online casino enthusiasts a secure, responsive, and highly entertaining online gaming hub.

Games and providers at Panda Zino Casino 

At Panda Zino Casino, our game library houses over 5,000 titles developed by 43 of the world’s leading software studios. We partner with software developers such as NetEnt, Pragmatic Play, Nolimit City, Play'n GO, Hacksaw Gaming, Relax Gaming, Novomatic, and Yggdrasil to bring you certified, high-quality entertainment.

 Every software game on our platform utilizes certified Random Number Generators (RNG) to guarantee that every outcome is entirely fair, random, and unbiased. Furthermore, game return-to-player (RTP) figures are displayed across our titles, generally ranging between 92% and 98%.

Video Slots and Classic Reel Games

Slots form the backbone of our casino catalog. We offer a range of mechanics designed to keep gameplay engaging, including traditional 3-reel classic slots, modern 5-reel video slots, grid-based cluster-pay titles, and volatile Megaways titles featuring up to 117,649 ways to win.

For players seeking immediate feature rounds, our Bonus Buy collection lets you bypass standard spins to enter bonus rounds directly. Popular slot titles in our lobby include:

  • Big Bass Bonanza & Big Bass Splash: Highly engaging fishing-themed titles from Pragmatic Play featuring rewarding collection mechanics.

  • Book of Dead: The classic Play'n GO Egyptian adventure known for expanding scatter symbols during free spins.

  • Sweet Bonanza: A cluster-pay slot filled with tumbling reels and random multipliers up to 100x.

  • Gates of Olympus: A Zeus-themed slot packed with random multiplier orbs and cascading wins.

Live Dealer Tables

If you prefer the authentic atmosphere of a land-based floor, our Live Dealer section brings real-time table action directly to your desktop or mobile screen. Broadcast in HD from professional studios, our live games are hosted by professional, real-life dealers. You can try your hand at the following games:

  • Live Roulette: Experience European, American, and speed variants, alongside multiplier-enhanced games like Lightning Roulette.

  • Live Blackjack: Take a seat at standard 7-seat tables, Unlimited Blackjack tables, or VIP high-roller tables with customizable side bets.

  • Live Baccarat & Poker: Play Classic Baccarat, Speed Baccarat, No Commission Baccarat, and live poker variants like Casino Hold'em and Three Card Poker.

  • Interactive Live Game Shows: Engage with entertaining hosted game shows, including Crazy Time, Monopoly Live, Sweet Bonanza Candyland, and Mega Wheel.

Board Games

Software table games give players complete control over their own pace through classic, single-player digital casino experiences. This category includes traditional favorites such as video roulette, classic blackjack, and baccarat, alongside popular video poker machines like Jacks or Better and Deuces Wild.

Crash

Instant Win and Crash Games offer a fast-paced, arcade-style experience built around dynamic timing and flexible risk management. Featuring popular titles such as Aviator, Spaceman, Mines, and Plinko, these games replace standard card hands or roulette spins with a rising multiplier. Rather than playing out a traditional turn, players must decide exactly when to cash out in real time before the multiplier suddenly crashes, directly controlling their potential payouts and level of risk.

How to Register at Pandazino Casino

Getting started at Pandazino Casino is fast, straightforward, and secure.

Follow these simple steps to set up your account and start playing in under two minutes:

  1. Start Registration: Click the prominent "Sign Up" button located in the top-right corner of our homepage.

  2. Enter Account Info: Fill in your valid email address and create a strong, secure password.

  3. Select Currency: Choose British Pounds (£) as your preferred account currency to ensure zero transaction fees.

  4. Confirm Profile Details: Provide basic contact information, including your full name, date of birth, and home address.

  5. Claim Your Welcome Bonus: Go to the cashier, enter the promo code ZEN1 during your first deposit of £20 or more, and enjoy your 400% match bonus plus 150 free spins immediately!

  1. Proof of Identification: A valid passport, national ID card, or photocard driving license.

  2. Proof of Address: A utility bill, internet statement, or bank document issued within the past 3 months.

  3. Payment Method Verification: A photo or screenshot confirming ownership of the deposit method used.

Our verification team processes documents within 24 to 48 hours to ensure your account is fully verified for seamless payouts. Furthermore, our team provides 24/7 support through live chat and email to assist you whenever you need help.

To ensure account security, a robust KYC verification process requires players to submit a government ID and proof of address prior to processing any cashouts. 

Payment Methods at Pandazino Casino

Managing your funds at Pandazino Casino is simple, safe, and transparent. We support 26 distinct banking options, accepting standard debit cards, instant open-banking transfers, trusted e-wallets, prepaid vouchers, and top cryptocurrencies. All transactions are processed natively in Pound Sterling (£), protecting UK players from foreign transaction fees.

mainEntity.name: How do I register an account at Pandazino Casino?

acceptedAnswer.text: Registering at Pandazino takes less than two minutes. Click the "Sign Up" button on our homepage, enter your email address, select a secure password, and select British Pounds (£) as your currency. Once registered, you can make your first deposit, enter code ZEN1, and start playing immediately.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum deposit and withdrawal limit at Pandazino?

acceptedAnswer.text: The minimum deposit at Pandazino Casino starts at £10 for cards, e-wallets, and crypto, and £20 for open banking. The minimum withdrawal limit across all available cashout methods is £20.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a promo code to claim the welcome bonus?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. To claim our welcome package, enter the bonus code ZEN1 on your first deposit, ZEN2 on your second deposit, and ZEN3 on your third deposit in the cashier field prior to confirming payment.

mainEntity.name: How fast are withdrawals processed at Pandazino Casino?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cashout requests undergo an internal verification check that takes between 24 and 48 hours. Once approved, e-wallet and cryptocurrency payouts clear within a few hours (or under 2 hours for crypto), while card and open banking withdrawals typically take between 1 and 3 business days to reach your account.

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need to submit to verify my account (KYC)?

acceptedAnswer.text: To complete the Know Your Customer (KYC) verification before cashing out, you need to provide a valid proof of identification (passport, national ID, or driving license), a proof of address issued within the past 3 months (utility bill or bank statement), and a screenshot or photo verifying ownership of your chosen payment method.
